description: This file defines a PHP class 'Location' in the Opencart admin module, responsible for CRUD operations on location data stored in a database. It contains methods for adding, editing, deleting, retrieving single locations, multiple locations with filters, and counting total locations.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: A model class for handling location data within the Opencart admin localisation module, providing CRUD and query operations.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Inserts a new location record into the database using the provided data and returns the new location ID.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Updates an existing location record identified by location_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes a location record identified by location_id from the database.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a single location record by its location_id.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves multiple location records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLocations
methods.description: Returns the total count of location records in the database.
